title: Pipeline operator routing profile
description: Local remove-and-rank preferences for policy-derived routing options. Credentials and account secrets are forbidden.

probe.$comment: ARGV ARRAY, never a shell string. usage-probe.sh executes this directly without sh -c: no metacharacters, no word splitting, no globbing, no chaining. probe[0] must resolve on the reset PATH or be an absolute path to an executable regular file. Use the literal string "none" for a rail with no probe.

precedence.$comment: TRACKED CANONICAL DEFINITION of remove-only precedence for operator profiles. routing-policy.json operatorProfile.precedenceRef points here. Kept in a tracked plugin reference rather than a plans/ prompt, because plans/ is gitignored and never reaches a user's plugin cache.
precedence.description: Remove-only precedence: an operator profile may reorder (RANK) and drop (REMOVE) options that policy derivation already produced. It may never ADD a routing provider that derivation did not find, never override neverOfferable, never relax a security invariant, and never override the family-independence rule for the second perspective or the security sign-off. Declaring a subscription rail supplies headroom observability only and does not by itself make a provider routable. With no profile present, policy defaults apply unchanged.
